entities.name: Kastral
entities.description: A legendary bluejay birdfolk scout from Bloomburrow, an elite Windcrested squad leader who returned seven seasons after her funeral.

entities.name: Plumecreed
entities.description: The journey to the Tip of the World that Windcrested complete.

entities.name: Calamity Beasts
entities.description: Beasts Kastral had to run from.

events.summary: Kastral completes the Plumecreed and flies to the Tip of the World.
events.quote: Kastral has flown to the Tip of the World and completed the Plumecreed

events.summary: Kastral is lost after a strange lightning storm breaks her wing and sends her off course.
events.quote: she'd been lost after a strange, massive lightning storm suddenly appeared and sent her far off her path with a broken wing

events.summary: Kastral returns seven seasons after her funeral, changed and faster.
events.quote: Kastral is known for returning from her Plumecreed journey seven seasons after her funeral

relations.note: Is a member and squad leader.
relations.quote: As a member of the Windcrested , Kastral has flown to the Tip of the World
